steps.say: Interstitial lung disease is affecting more than 80 percent of diffuse systemic sclerosis and 30 percent of limited disease. HRCT is showing basilar ground-glass opacities with traction bronchiectasis in a non-specific interstitial pneumonia pattern. Mycophenolate mofetil or nintedanib is used for treatment. Lung fibrosis is leading even when skin changes are minimal.
steps.tx: **Interstitial lung disease (SSc-ILD)** is affecting more than **80 percent** of diffuse systemic sclerosis and **30 percent** of limited disease. **HRCT** of the chest is showing basilar **ground-glass opacities** with **traction bronchiectasis** in a **non-specific interstitial pneumonia (NSIP)** pattern. Treatment is based on **mycophenolate mofetil** or **nintedanib**. Lung fibrosis is leading even when skin changes are minimal.

vis.alt: Diagram illustrating systemic sclerosis affecting multiple organs, including lungs (ILD, PAH), kidneys (renal crisis), and gut (GAVE).
vis.caption: Systemic sclerosis: Multi-organ involvement

steps.say: Pulmonary arterial hypertension is group 1 pulmonary hypertension affecting 10 to 15 percent of systemic sclerosis patients. Diagnosis is requiring right heart catheterization with mean pulmonary artery pressure more than 20, wedge pressure 15 or less, and vascular resistance more than 2 Wood units. Endothelin receptor antagonists with PDE-5 inhibitors are forming the treatment backbone. Breathlessness is raising both lung and vessel alarms.
steps.tx: **Pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH, group 1 pulmonary hypertension)** is affecting **10 to 15 percent** of systemic sclerosis patients. Diagnosis is requiring **right heart catheterization** with **mean pulmonary artery pressure more than 20 mmHg**, **wedge pressure 15 mmHg or less**, and **vascular resistance more than 2 Wood units**. Treatment is combining **endothelin receptor antagonists** with **PDE-5 inhibitors**. Breathlessness is raising both lung and vessel alarms.

rows: 10 to 15 percent of systemic sclerosis patients
Right heart catheterization: mean pressure more than 20, wedge 15 or less, resistance more than 2 Wood units
Endothelin receptor antagonists with PDE-5 inhibitors

steps.say: Scleroderma renal crisis is an acute hypertensive emergency affecting 5 to 10 percent of diffuse systemic sclerosis patients. Glucocorticoids at prednisone 15 mg or more per day and anti-RNA polymerase III are acting as triggers. Emergency treatment is using oral captopril without delay. Steroids are fueling the fire that captopril is quenching.
steps.tx: **Scleroderma renal crisis (SRC)** is an acute **hypertensive emergency** affecting **5 to 10 percent** of diffuse systemic sclerosis patients. **Glucocorticoids** at **prednisone 15 mg or more per day** and **anti-RNA polymerase III** are acting as triggers. Emergency treatment is using oral **captopril** without delay. Steroids are fueling the fire that captopril is quenching.

vis.alt: Bisected kidney with cortical ischemic infarcts, an arteriole with onion-skin intimal proliferation and fibrinoid necrosis, and schistocytes of microangiopathic haemolysis in scleroderma renal crisis.
vis.caption: Scleroderma renal crisis: onion-skin arterioles and cortical infarcts. Triggers and treatment are in the text, not on the drawing (StewardMD).

steps.say: Gastrointestinal involvement is affecting more than 90 percent of systemic sclerosis patients. Lower esophageal sphincter incompetence is causing severe reflux with Barrett esophagus. Gastric antral vascular ectasia is causing chronic iron deficiency anemia with watermelon stripes on endoscopy. Reflux is burning while vessels are leaking.
steps.tx: **Gastrointestinal involvement** is affecting more than **90 percent** of systemic sclerosis patients. **Lower esophageal sphincter incompetence** is causing severe **gastroesophageal reflux** with **Barrett esophagus**. **Gastric antral vascular ectasia (GAVE, watermelon stomach)** is causing chronic **iron deficiency anemia** with watermelon stripes on endoscopy. Reflux is burning while vessels are leaking.

rows: Watermelon stripes with chronic iron deficiency anemia

steps.say: Small intestinal dysmotility is causing pseudo-obstruction with bacterial overgrowth. Chronic watery diarrhea with bloating and malabsorption is marking the presentation. Hydrogen breath testing is confirming the diagnosis. Rotating courses of rifaximin are clearing the overgrowth and restoring absorption.
steps.tx: **Small intestinal dysmotility** is causing **pseudo-obstruction** with small intestinal bacterial overgrowth (**SIBO**). Chronic **watery diarrhea** with **bloating** and **malabsorption** is marking the presentation. **Hydrogen breath testing** is confirming the diagnosis. Rotating courses of **rifaximin** are clearing the overgrowth and restoring absorption.

rows: Chronic watery diarrhea with bloating and malabsorption

steps.say: Myocardial fibrosis is causing patchy contraction band necrosis in diffuse disease. Diastolic dysfunction is progressing to heart failure with preserved ejection fraction. Ventricular arrhythmias are complicating the course. Late gadolinium enhancement on cardiac MRI is revealing the scar.
steps.tx: **Myocardial fibrosis** in diffuse systemic sclerosis is causing patchy **contraction band necrosis**. **Diastolic dysfunction** is progressing to **heart failure with preserved ejection fraction (HFpEF)**. **Ventricular arrhythmias** are complicating the course. **Late gadolinium enhancement** on **cardiac MRI** is revealing the scar.

rows: Heart failure with preserved ejection fraction
Late gadolinium enhancement on cardiac MRI

steps.say: Calcinosis cutis is depositing calcium hydroxyapatite under skin and around joints. Chronic painful ulcerations with secondary infections are complicating the lumps and prolonging healing. Surgical debridement is removing the deposits. Diltiazem or sodium thiosulfate is calming the calcium and easing the pain.

Chronic painful **ulcerations** with secondary **infections** are complicating the lumps and prolonging healing. **Surgical debridement** is removing the deposits. **Diltiazem** or **sodium thiosulfate** is calming the calcium and easing the pain.

steps.say: Autologous hematopoietic stem cell transplantation is following immunoablative conditioning. Skin scores with pulmonary function are improving after the reset. Long-term event-free survival is lengthening in responders. Transplant is rescuing rapidly progressive poor-prognosis diffuse disease that is failing conventional DMARDs.
steps.tx: **Autologous hematopoietic stem cell transplantation (AHSCT)** is following **immunoablative conditioning**. **Skin scores** with **pulmonary function** are improving after the reset. Long-term **event-free survival** is lengthening in responders. Transplant is rescuing rapidly progressive poor-prognosis diffuse disease that is failing conventional **DMARDs**.
